coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (phase 0/1). All three arms are registered as ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but are study arms; Part A tests senicapoc alone, Part B compares perampanel alone vs perampanel plus senicapoc, so both drugs are investigational: coded experimental_combination because the combination arm is the main question (monotherapy arms exist). Temozolomide is not named; it is inferred from the Stupp regimen that all patients receive.
